reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Maryland
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Does the law require landlords to describe repercussions for failure to cure
     when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?"
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

state(maryland).
focus_year(2021).

role(landlord1, landlord).
role(tenant1, tenant).
property(property1).

/* A landlord gave a tenant a notice to vacate. */
notice_to_vacate(notice1, landlord1, tenant1, property1).
/* Whether the notice describes repercussions for failure to cure is not asserted by the question. */
notice_mentions_repercussions_for_failure_to_cure(notice1, unknown).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(maryland),
    focus_year(2021),
    role(landlord1, landlord),
    role(tenant1, tenant),
    property(property1),
    notice_to_vacate(notice1, landlord1, tenant1, property1).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute translations (as provided)
   NOTE: The provided statutes are tax/personnel provisions, not landlord-tenant notice rules.
   We still encode their duties/thresholds/rights as required.
   ----------------------------- */

/* Generic representation of statutory duties for this knowledge base. */
statute_duty(maryland, 2021, 'MD Tax-Gen 8-402.1', pay_franchise_tax, public_service_company).
statute_duty(maryland, 2021, 'MD State Pers. & Pens. 8-402', may_recover_money_paid_in_violation, officer_or_surety).

/* --- MD. Tax - General Code Ann.  8-402.1 (2021) ---
   Encodes:
   (a)(1) Franchise tax imposed each calendar year on each public service company engaged in
          transmission/distribution/delivery of electricity or natural gas in the State.
   (a)(2) Tax measured by kWh electricity or therms natural gas delivered for final consumption in the State.
   (b) Exemption: tax does not apply to therms of natural gas delivered for final consumption by a PSC that is
       (1) a county; or (2) a municipal corporation.
*/

/* Minimal domain predicates used by the statute encoding. */
public_service_company(Company) :-
    nonvar(Company),
    Company \= none.

engaged_in_delivery_in_state(Company, maryland, Commodity) :-
    public_service_company(Company),
    ( Commodity = electricity
    ; Commodity = natural_gas
    ).

/* Quantity is "for final consumption in the State". We represent this as a fact-like predicate. */
delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(_Company, maryland, _Commodity, Quantity) :-
    number(Quantity),
    Quantity >= 0.

measured_by_unit(electricity, kilowatt_hours).
measured_by_unit(natural_gas, therms).

/* Exemption status for natural gas therms delivered for final consumption. */
is_county(_Entity) :- fail.
is_municipal_corporation(_Entity) :- fail.

/* The tax applies to a company's delivery of a commodity unless the natural-gas county/municipal exemption applies. */
franchise_tax_applies_to_delivery(Company, Year, maryland, Commodity, Quantity, Unit) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 0,
    engaged_in_delivery_in_state(Company, maryland, Commodity),
    delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(Company, maryland, Commodity, Quantity),
    measured_by_unit(Commodity, Unit),
    \+ franchise_tax_exempt_delivery(Company, Commodity).

franchise_tax_exempt_delivery(Company, natural_gas) :-
    ( is_county(Company)
    ; is_municipal_corporation(Company)
    ).

franchise_tax_exempt_delivery(_Company, electricity) :-
    fail.

/* --- MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-402 (2021) ---
   Encodes:
   "Money paid in violation of this section or ... may be recovered from the officer ... or sureties ..."
*/

/* Abstract violation and recovery model. */
money_paid_in_violation(_Payment) :- fail.

officer_who_paid_or_authorized(_Officer, _Payment) :- fail.
surety_on_official_bond(_Surety, _Officer) :- fail.

may_recover_from(RecoveryTarget, Payment) :-
    money_paid_in_violation(Payment),
    ( officer_who_paid_or_authorized(RecoveryTarget, Payment)
    ; ( surety_on_official_bond(RecoveryTarget, Officer),
        officer_who_paid_or_authorized(Officer, Payment)
      )
    ).

/* -----------------------------
   Legal reasoning for the housing question
   ----------------------------- */

/* We model the queried legal requirement as existence of a statute-duty imposing it.
   Because the provided statutes contain no landlord-tenant notice-to-vacate content,
   no such duty exists in this knowledge base.
*/
requires_landlord_to_describe_repercussions_for_failure_to_cure_in_notice(State, Year) :-
    statute_duty(State, Year, _Citation, include_repercussions_in_notice_to_vacate, landlord).

/* -----------------------------
   Final answer predicate
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    requires_landlord_to_describe_repercussions_for_failure_to_cure_in_notice(State, Year),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require landlords to describe repercussions for failure to cure when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?
